map.退税 = 金额 × 退税率；手续费 = 退税 × 费率；到手 = 退税 − 手续: Refund = amount × refund rate; commission = refund × rate; received = refund − commission
map.按购物金额与退税率计算应退税额，扣除手续费后为实际到手；未达起退点不予退税，外币: Compute the refundable tax from the purchase amount and refund rate; after deducting the commission it is the actual amount received; amounts below the threshold are not refunded; foreign currency is converted at the given rate.
map.💡 公式：应退税额 = 购物金额 × 退税率；手续费 = 应退税额 × 手续费率: 💡 Formula: refundable tax = purchase amount × refund rate; commission = refundable tax × commission rate; actual received = refundable tax − commission. Below the threshold the purchase is not refunded.

map.算法：应退税额 = 金额 × 退税率；手续费 = 应退税额 × 手续费率；实际到: Algorithm: refundable tax = amount × refund rate; commission = refundable tax × commission rate; actual received = refundable tax − commission; net spend = amount − actual received; CNY received = actual received × rate; when threshold>0 the amount must be ≥ threshold to qualify.

map.手续费为什么单独算？: Why is the commission calculated separately?
map.退税代理常按比例抽佣（如 3%），直接从退税额扣；部分为固定费。比例越高到手越少: Refund agents often take a percentage cut (e.g. 3%) directly from the refund; some charge a fixed fee. A higher rate means less received, so comparing agents is necessary.
map.部分国家/商家设单张小票最低退税金额（如 200 外币）；低于门槛不予退税，合并: Some countries / merchants set a minimum refund amount per receipt (e.g. 200 foreign units); below the threshold no refund; combining receipts or meeting the minimum can trigger it.
